groups.sentence: Meeting hosts obtain consent from all participants before recording or transcribing with AI, and recording does not begin until everyone consents.
Everyone announces at the start of a meeting that AI recording or transcription is active.
Students obtain the instructor's permission before recording class sessions or lectures, including with AI tools.
Hosts disable AI recording or transcription features when inappropriate or when a participant does not consent.
Everyone does not use AI recording or transcription tools in confidential, sensitive or HR meetings, or allow unfamiliar bots to join meetings.
Participants ask the host whether recording or AI transcription is enabled, and decline to take part if the host insists.
Everyone does not create or distribute images, audio, video or likenesses of real people, including deepfakes, without their explicit consent.
Students do not use AI tools to transcribe, record, take notes on or summarize course lectures, unless approved as an accommodation.
AI recording raises privacy concerns and may violate wiretapping laws; existing rules on recording classes apply.
Students have the right to attend classes without being recorded by AI tools.
Everyone balances productivity and convenience with respect for privacy and treats recordings as private among those who took part.
